買えるようになったら
いよいよ船を買うときですね
records.previous_English: Once your market share grows and you can buy more goods, it's time to buy a ship.
records.english: Once your market share grows and you can buy more goods, it's time to buy a ship.
protected_phrases: it's time to buy a ship.
records.context: The ship-buying lesson moves from limited purchases and increasing market share to matching hull size and staffing to what the fleet can carry.

lines: and you can buy more goods,
it's time to buy a ship.

records.speaker: Cesare Tony
records.Japanese:
ここでまず考えるべきは
船の大きさと値段であります
records.previous_English: Start with the ship's size and price.
records.english: Start with the ship's size and price.
records.context: The ship-buying lesson moves from limited purchases and increasing market share to matching hull size and staffing to what the fleet can carry.
records.localization_note: Size and cost are the first things to consider. The short direct instruction segues into the budget example.

records.speaker: Cesare Tony
records.Japanese:
シェアと所持金に応じた船を
選ばなければ、船一杯に積めるだけの
交易品を買えないのに、結局
水夫ばかり必要になってしまいます
records.previous_English: Buy a ship your market share and budget can support. Otherwise you'll need more sailors for a ship you can't fill.
records.english: Buy a ship your market share and budget can support. Otherwise you'll need more sailors for a ship you can't fill.
records.context: The ship-buying lesson moves from limited purchases and increasing market share to matching hull size and staffing to what the fleet can carry.
records.localization_note: The example makes clear that additional sailors do not help a fleet that cannot fill its cargo space.

records.speaker: Cesare Tony
records.Japanese:
中型船には２本マストと３本マストが
あります。もちろん、３本マストの
ほうが速いのですが
操帆手が多く必要になるのであります
records.previous_English: Medium ships have two or three masts. The ones with three are faster, but they need more sail handlers.
records.english: Medium ships have two or three masts. The ones with three are faster, but they need more sail handlers.
records.context: The ship-buying lesson moves from limited purchases and increasing market share to matching hull size and staffing to what the fleet can carry.
records.localization_note: The first sentence is too long for a single native row. Retain the existing subject lead and keep two or three masts together before the separate tradeoff.

records.speaker: Cesare Tony
records.Japanese:
改造すれば、積荷倉庫を最大の５部屋
まで取れます。当面の間、戦わない
つもりならば海兵詰所や砲台は
いりませんからね
records.previous_English: Refit for up to five cargo holds. If you won't fight for a while, skip marine quarters and gun batteries.
records.english: Refit for up to five cargo holds. If you won't fight for a while, skip marine quarters and gun batteries.
records.context: The ship-buying lesson moves from limited purchases and increasing market share to matching hull size and staffing to what the fleet can carry.
records.localization_note: The five-hold maximum and the conditional advice about marine quarters and guns stay factual.

records.speaker: Maria Li
records.Japanese:
意外ね…
船にしか興味がない人だと
思っていたわ
records.previous_English: I never would have guessed... I thought all you cared about was ships.
records.english: I never would have guessed... I thought all you cared about was ships.
records.context: The crew talks about the poetry and appeal of the sea. A crewmate's jubilant victory interjection prompts a dry exception before the group returns to the theme.
records.localization_note: Her surprise at a man she thought cared only about ships gives the next reflection a reason to begin.

records.speaker: Xien Yan
records.Japanese:
いやいや
違うぞFI
海の男たる者、誰もが
心にロマンを持つものじゃ
records.previous_English: Not so, FI. Every man of the sea carries a little poetry in his heart.
records.english: Not so, FI. Every man of the sea carries a little poetry in his heart.
records.context: The crew talks about the poetry and appeal of the sea. A crewmate's jubilant victory interjection prompts a dry exception before the group returns to the theme.
records.localization_note: Keep the original given name and the old sailor's general claim about poetry.

records.Japanese:

勝利の宴だぜ！！
イヤッホゥ！

records.Japanese:
FIさんが教えて
くれたんだ。『リルが危ない！』って
